title: dumpcap: slightly untwist the maze of code paths.
description:
Pull together a bunch of code involved in opening a capture device into
a routine named cap_device_open - no need for "_live", if you open a
capture device it's for live capture.

Rename the routine for opening a capture pipe to cap_pipe_open(), for
the same reason. Rename the routines that it calls and that read the
rest of the SHB for pcapng files, and the rest ofthe file header for
pcap files, to indicate that's what they do.

Add, expand, and fix comments.
